title: The Dynamics Lab's engine
about: kinesis (the language of dynamical systems, what a declared law does over time, braids of trajectories, and laws recovered from records) on calx, morphe, physis and tyche, compiled once with g++ 11 or later, natively or in WSL, into data/cache/engines/dynamics-lab/. About a minute and a half; it is compiled again when its sources change. The Lab needs no data.
